tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs brag phug pas mdzad pa kha skong dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud la byin gyis rlobs// gnas 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs// gsol ba= /gnas zag med sgyu ma'i pho brang du// bdag med lha mo bco lnga la gsol= /gsol ba= /gnas so wa na tha'i gnas mchog tu// grub chen rnal 'byor dbang phyug la gsol= /gsol ba= /gnas ri bo u tsa ya na'i dur khrod du// brtul zhugs nag po spyod pa la gsol= /gsol ba= /gnas rgya gar ka ma ru pa'i grong khyer du// rgyal rigs ḍā ma ru pa la gsol= /gsol ba= /gnas shar phyogs mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i ljongs lung du// gnyis spangs ā wā d+dhu ti la= /gsol ba= /gnas kha reg thod phu'i yang dben du// paṇa grub gha ya dha ra la= /gsol ba= /gnas mang mkhar mu khu lung gi gnas mchog tu// sgra bsgyur 'brog mi lo tsā la= /gsol ba= /gnas mkhar chung chu kha'i gnas mchog tu// bla ma se ston kun rig la= /gsol ba= /gnas sag thang deng gi dgon pa ru// bla ma zhang ston chos 'bar la= /gsol ba= /gnas skya bo kha gdangs kyi gnas mchog tu// sa chen kun dga' snying po la= /gsol ba= /gnas chu mig rdzing kha'i gnas mchog tu// slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo la= /gsol ba= /gnas sgo rum bla ma'i gzim khang du// rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la= /gsol ba= /gnas byang phyogs sprul pa'i lha khang du// chos rje sa skya paṇa chen la= /gsol ba= /gnas lha khang bla brang gi gnas mchog tu// 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa la= /gsol ba= /gnas skye phreng bla ma'i gzim khang du// zhang ston dkon mchog dpal ba la= /gsol ba= /gnas sger phu rdzing lung gi gnas mchog tu// tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal ba la=

/gsol ba= /gnas nyan po bla ma'i gzim khang du// nyan chen bsod nams bstan pa la= /gsol ba= /gnas na bza' brag phug gi dben gnas su// grub chen brag phug pa chen po la= /gsol ba= /gnas bsam yas bla brang gi gzim khang du// chos rje bla ma dam pa la= /gsol ba= /gnas byang chub rdzong gi gnas mchog tu// chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims la= /gsol ba= /gnas zhi dgon rgyal ba'i ri khrod du// grub chen bud+dha shrī la= /gsol ba= /gnas e wam̐ chos ldan gyi dgon pa ru// ngor chen kun dga' bzang po la= /gsol ba= /mus bsam gtan gling gi dben gnas su// mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la= /gsol ba= /gnas dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag tu// bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen la= /gsol ba= /gnas kha'u brag rdzong gi ri khrod du// rje btsun kun spangs pa chen po la= /gsol ba= /gnas bo dong phun tshogs rab brtan tu// sgo rum kun dga' legs pa la= /gsol ba= /gnas grang chen khang gsar dben gnas su// tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho la= /gsol ba= /gnas bo dong pho brang dkar po ru// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la= /gsol ba= /gnas sgrub sde rje yi yang dgon du// rje btsun sding ma ba chen po la= /gsol ba= /gnas 'dar stod chos dbyings pho brang du// grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan la= /gsol ba= /gnas bkra shis chos sde'i pho brang du// mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan la= /gsol ba= /gnas zhwa lu chos 'khor shar chen du// rin chen bsod nams mchog grub la= /gsol ba= /gnas bco brgyad rdo rje'i pho brang du// mkhyen rab ngag gi dbang phyug la= /gsol ba= /gnas smon dga' bsam gling dben gnas su// rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub la= /gsol ba= /gnas rgyal khams phyogs med kyi pho brang du// kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas la= /gsol ba= /gnas 'dod dgu gling gi bzhugs gnas su// mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin lhun grub la=

/gsol ba= /gnas chos rdzong shar gyi yang dben du// ngag dbang blo gsal phun tshogs la= /gsol ba= /gnas nges gsang snying po'i pho brang du// lha btsun 'khor lo'i mgon po la= /gsol ba= /gnas 'brug sgur dben pa'i ri khrod du// dge 'dun bkra shis dpal 'byor la= /gsol ba= /gnas gzim 'og bkra shis mthong smon du// ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags la= /gsol ba= /gnas bco brgyad lcang lo can nyid du// rin chen mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la= /gsol ba= /gnas gzim 'og srid gsum dpal 'byor du// ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin la= /gsol ba= /gnas mos gus gzhom med kyi pho brang du// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la= /gsol ba= /gnas snying ga chos kyi pho brang du// yi dam dgyes pa rdo rje la= /gsol ba= /gnas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rang bzhin du// dam chos gsung ngag lam 'bras la= /gsol ba= /gnas rang snang dag pa'i zhing khams su// mched grogs rdo rje'i spun grogs la= /gsol ba= /gnas sgo rum kha'u'i mgon khang du// chos skyong gur zhal rnam gnyis la= /gsol ba= /lus la bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs// ngag la skye 'gags bral bar byin= /sems la bde stong skye bar byin= /'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bdag dang bltos par bcas pa'i 'gro ba rnams// bar chad lam du nam yang mi 'gro zhing*// byin rlabs rgyun chad med pa'i bkra shis stsol// ces pa 'di ni zhang dkon mchog dpal yan chad grub chen brag phug pas tho rengs zhig na bza' brag phug tu gsung ngag bla ma brgyud pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la zhal gzigs dus nyams 'ur gyi ngang nas mdzad pa brag phug pas tshogs gral tu rgyun par zhal 'don mdzad pa/ 'di man chad bla ma so sos kha skong slar mdzad/ 'di gzhan las 'khrul stobs che ba yin gsungs nas/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos thugs rtsis che ba yin 'dug pa'i nyams rtog 'dod pa'i lam 'bras pa rnams kyi kha ton du bya'o// zhes pa don gnyer ba rnams la mkho ba'i blos nye bar bris pa'o//
// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
